abstract:
|
  Implemented the #65 citation-resolver gate per brief, verifying base at 4f2ae97 before any edit. Built scripts/tests/CitationResolverPolicy.Tests.ps1 following the CodeCitationPolicy.Tests.ps1/condition_severity_test.go precedent shape: scans tracked non-artifacts files (checked extensions .go/.js/.mjs/.css/.md/.json/.ps1/.psm1/.sh/.yml/.yaml, self-excluding its own source file), unwraps comment/prose line wraps onto the next line only when the current line ends in a bare hyphen (probed: this precondition is the exact signature of every genuine Class-C wrap in this corpus and eliminates 8 measured false positives from naive joining), and checks file existence (binding), line-range (binding), and a backtick-token content-anchor (report-only, measured n=9 too sparse to bind). Bare basenames resolve via a repo-wide map only when unique; ambiguous (2+) matches report by name without failing, as do ellipsis-elided (".../file.ext:N", the repo's own established truncation convention) and explicitly-marked historical citations.

  Calibration at landing (258 source files scanned, 192 coordinates found): fixed 2 real Class-A defects (a pre-migration docs/reviews/ path in two files, retargeted to artifacts/reviews/ with content/line verified unchanged via git mv), added 1 historical-marker exemption, and re-verified rather than blindly fixed the issue's own "3 more dead citations" calibration-input claim - found FALSE as stated (all three resolve true against docs/templates/gating-matrix.md, not the differently-named contracts file the claim implicitly assumed), disclosed with measurement.

  Red-first non-vacuity was proven against the REAL repo for all three classes via targeted fault injection (dead path, out-of-range line, and a genuine line-wrapped citation at board/web/test/sse-protocol.test.js:8-9), each observed red with the exact failure message quoted verbatim, each reverted byte-identical with sha256 verified before and after. Permanent scratch-repo Pester fixtures additionally pin all three classes, the false-join-suppression guard, and both exemption mechanisms for every future CI run.

  Full suites confirmed green at final HEAD 3d76e65: scripts/tests 206/0/4-skipped/210, scripts/probes 24/24, Go 85/85 + go vet clean, Node 129/129 (post npm install in this fresh worktree), probe-yard-snapshot.mjs PASS. One disclosed deviation: the gate's own source needed self-exclusion from its own scan, matching CodeCitationPolicy's existing precedent for self-referential worked-example collisions.
